(2) L100 claims THE FOUR SHAPES is exclusive scope, but Growth Strategist survives at L10, L64, L117 (35-point bucket) and L213, so a scorer would rank a shape the block says is out of scope.

The Workable ATS addition is wired at ingestion (Step 1a) but never propagated to Step 4 presentation (L190) or Step 5 write (L200). Separately, shape 4 'all channel' is defined at L102 but never given a point value in the Step 3 mechanism table — undefined whether it scores 35 or 28; the worked examples state keep/reject but never a score.

Searched placement/frontmatter (project skill in .claude/skills/, no alex: prefix), Notion-plan constraint compliance (notion-search/notion-fetch, no query-data-sources), and MCP tool references (Dice, Apollo, Notion) — all correct and house-consistent. Not 1.0 only because me-model.md 1.5, which this rubric explicitly mirrors and must stay in sync with, was not in the bundle and could not be checked.

No over-engineering, no hardcoded secrets, lean curl+jq, dedupe against the Notion DB. Docked for duplicated state: the top-level target statement (L10) was left untouched when the competing, more recent FOUR SHAPES block was added below, leaving two unreconciled statements of scope in one file.
